item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "Even Shouting 'Long Live Kim Il-sung' in the Heart of Seoul Should Be Allowed" (이병태 “서울 한복판에서 ‘김일성 만세’ 외쳐도 허용돼야”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae: "Even Shouting 'Long Live Kim Il-sung' in the Heart of Seoul Should Be Allowed" (이병태 “서울 한복판에서 ‘김일성 만세’ 외쳐도 허용돼야”)

Lee Byung-tae, vice chairman of the Presidential Regulatory Reform Committee, said on the 4th regarding Baejae High School's baseball team receiving heavy disciplinary action over the 'Starbucks cheer chant' controversy, "Even shouting 'Long Live Kim Il-sung' in the heart of Seoul should be allowed." Regarding calls for his resignation from some within the ruling bloc, he dismissed them, saying, "Criticism is also freedom of expression." (이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장은 4일 배재고 야구부가 ‘스타벅스 응원 구호’ 논란으로 중징계를 받은 것에 대해 “서울 한복판에서 ‘김일성 만세’를 외쳐도 허용돼야 한다”고 했다. 여권 일각에서 나오는 사퇴 요구에 대해선 “비판도 표현의 자유”라며 일축했다.)

On the 4th, Vice Chairman Lee posted an article titled "Freedom of Expression and Baseball Cheer Chants" on his Facebook page, stating, "Freedom of expression is a fundamental right to speak thoughts that the majority disagrees with, without fear of punishment," and thus expressed this view. (이 부위원장은 4일 자신의 페이스북에 ‘표현의 자유 그리고 야구 응원 구호’라는 제목의 글을 올려 “표현의 자유는 다수가 동의하지 않는 생각을 처벌의 두려움 없이 말할 수 있는 기본권”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Vice Chairman Lee said, "The core of freedom of expression is not censorship but belief in the 'self-purifying power of truth.' It is not the right to say what is right and correct, but a fundamental right for society to allow even wrong, absurd, and false statements." He added, "The crazy words of a minority are purified by the truth of the majority." (이 부위원장은 “표현의 자유의 핵심은 검열이 아니라 ‘진리의 자정 능력’을 믿는 것”이라며 “옳고 바른 말을 할 권리가 아니라, 틀리고 엉뚱하고 거짓된 말도 사회가 허용하라는 기본권”이라고 했다. 그는 “소수의 미친 소리는 다수의 진리에 의해 정화된다”고 했다.)

Regarding the calls from some within the ruling bloc for his resignation over his claim that Baejae High School's discipline was "like North Korea," he directly rebutted. Vice Chairman Lee said, "Whether the cheer chant was appropriate may vary from person to person," but added, "If it was inappropriate, one can criticize it. That criticism itself is freedom of expression, but punishing someone based on their speech is a denial of fundamental rights." (배재고 징계를 “북한과 같다”고 했던 자신의 주장을 두고 범여권 일각에서 사퇴 요구가 나오는 데 대해서도 정면 반박했다. 이 부위원장은 “응원 구호가 적절했는지는 사람마다 다를 것”이라면서도 “부적절했다면 비판하면 된다. 그 비판도 표현의 자유지만, 발언을 근거로 처벌하는 것은 기본권의 부인”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "Denying that this speech should be punished is a denial of the democracy pursued by the Gwangju Democratization Movement," adding, "A society where fundamental rights are not protected is not a democratic society. The desire for severe punishment starts from the sanctification of ideas." (이어 “이 발언이 처벌받아야 한다는 기본권의 부정은 광주 민주화운동이 추구했던 민주주의를 부정하는 것”이라며 “기본권이 지켜지지 않는 사회는 민주적 사회가 아니다. 엄벌의 욕구는 사상의 성역화에서 출발한다”고 했다.)

Vice Chairman Lee said, "I still firmly believe that the participants and victims of the Gwangju Democratization Movement fought for democracy in this land," and "If you agree with this, you must not deny the universally recognized fundamental right of democracy: freedom of expression." He added, "Protecting fundamental rights is how we complete the Gwangju Democratization Movement," and "That is why I believe it is not the students' chant but their punishment that mocks and belittles the Gwangju Democratization Movement." <<>> (이 부위원장은 “나는 광주 민주화 운동의 참여자나 희생자가 이 땅의 민주주의를 위해 싸웠다고 지금도 굳게 믿고 있다”며 “이것에 동의한다면 민주주의의 인류 보편적 기본권인 표현의 자유를 부인해서는 안 된다”고 했다. 그러면서 “기본권을 지키는 것이 광주 민주화운동을 완성하는 일”이라며 “그래서 나는 학생들의 구호가 아니라 그들의 처벌이 광주민주화운동의 조롱과 폄훼라고 믿는다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "If mega projects were a tool for approval ratings, I would have launched them before the local elections." (李 “메가 프로젝트, 지지율 수단이었다면 지방선거 전에 했을 것”)
item.description:
Lee: "If mega projects were a tool for approval ratings, I would have launched them before the local elections." (李 “메가 프로젝트, 지지율 수단이었다면 지방선거 전에 했을 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 4th, "If the three mega projects were a political tool for managing approval ratings, I would have started them before the local elections." (이재명 대통령은 4일 “3대 메가 프로젝트가 지지율 관리를 위한 정치적 수단이었다면 지방선거 전에 시작했을 것”이라고 했다.)

On X (formerly Twitter) that day, the President said, "It has long been my belief that approval ratings naturally follow from performance and results." This appears to be a response to political interpretations, such as claims from the political sphere that the government's announcement of a large-scale semiconductor cluster in the Honam region was "made with the Democratic Party's national convention in mind." (이 대통령은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 “지지율은 성과와 실적을 자연스럽게 따라온다는 게 저의 오래된 생각”이라며 이같이 밝혔다. 정부가 호남에 대규모 반도체 클러스터 조성을 발표한 것을 두고 정치권에서 ‘민주당 전당대회를 염두한 것’이라는 등의 정치적 해석이 나오는 데 따른 반응으로 보인다.)

The President added, "The grand transformation of the national territory—comparable to a sea change for a world-changing upheaval—has been a dream of mine long before my inauguration," and "Right after taking office, I made national-level preparations for large-scale local investment and development aimed at balanced growth, seeking cooperation from the business community, but progress was slow." (이 대통령은 “천지개벽을 위한 상전벽해 수준의 국토대전환은 제가 취임하기 전 아주 오래전부터 꿈꿔왔던 일”이라며 “취임 직후부터 균형발전을 위한 대규모 지방투자와 개발을 위해 국가 차원의 준비를 하며 경제계에 협조 요청을 해 왔는데 속도가 크게 나지 않았다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Then, recently, as the government's focus on investment in future advanced industries like artificial intelligence aligned with a structural, long-term, and explosive positive restructuring of the AI semiconductor industry, large-scale local investment became possible." (이어 “그러던 중 최근에 정부의 인공지능 등 미래 첨단선업 중점 투자정책과 인공지능 반도체 산업의 구조적이고 장기적이며 폭발적인 긍정적 재편이 맞물리며 대규모 지방투자가 가능하게 되었다”고 했다.)

The President also shared media reports showing a rebound in his approval ratings following the announcement of the three mega projects. His approval rating had fallen to 51% in a Gallup Korea survey released on the 26th of last month, threatening the 50% threshold, but it rebounded to 54% in the same survey released the previous day. (이 대통령은 3대 메가프로젝트 발표 후 국정 지지율이 반등했다는 언론 보도도 공유했다. 이 대통령 국정 지지율은 지난달 26일 발표된 한국갤럽 조사에서 51%까지 하락하며 50% 선이 위협받았는데, 전날 발표된 같은 조사에선 54%로 반등했다.)

The President said, "Approval ratings are important, but more important are the performance and results that improve the lives of the people," adding, "Approval ratings are like the wind—coming and going, sometimes strong, sometimes weak. But results and achievements are like a mountain—they don't change easily." (이 대통령은 “지지율도 중요하지만 더 중요한건 국민의 삶을 개선할 성과와 실적”이라며 “지지율은 바람같은 것이어서 오기도 가기도 하고, 강하기도 약하기도 하지만 실적과 성과는 산 같은 것이어서 쉽게 변하지 않는다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae Visits DJ’s Birthplace, Kim Min-seok Heads to Iksan... Wooing Honam Voters All Weekend (DJ 생가 간 정청래, 익산 간 김민석... 주말 내내 호남 표심 잡기)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae Visits DJ’s Birthplace, Kim Min-seok Heads to Iksan... Wooing Honam Voters All Weekend (DJ 생가 간 정청래, 익산 간 김민석... 주말 내내 호남 표심 잡기)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea’s August convention to elect its new leader, party leadership contenders visited the Honam region on the 4th. Jeong Cheong-rae, former Democratic Party leader, visited the birthplace of former President Kim Dae-jung in Sinan County, South Jeolla Province, while former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stayed at his home in Iksan, North Jeolla Province. <<> Jeong posted on Facebook that day, “I took a train at dawn and came to President Kim Dae-jung’s birthplace on Haeui Island in Sinan County, South Jeolla. I offered incense and paid my respects with a deep bow,” adding, “I also thought about your difficult life, from being a boy on a small Haeui Island village to becoming a global leader who shined with the Nobel Peace Prize, surpassing being a political leader of South Korea.” <<> Jeong said, “You survived five brushes with death, and each time you overcame those crises, Korean democracy took a step forward,” and “I will walk the path of democracy, human rights, and peace on the Korean Peninsula that President Kim Dae-jung first trod in modern Korean history.” He added, “I will think like Kim Dae-jung and act like Kim Dae-jung. I will be a conscience in action.” <<> Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok posted on X (formerly Twitter) that day, saying, “Spending the first weekend after retiring as prime minister, perhaps the first weekend in years since the martial law [incident], with some rest at my home in Iksan, North Jeolla,” and “I am envisioning a new leap forward from Iksan, beyond Iksan to North Jeolla, and further to South Korea.” <<> He added, “The Saemangeum Hyundai Motor investment, which I supported with great effort during my time as prime minister, will ultimately succeed only if the culture, healthcare, and education of the entire nearby region develop together,” and “Many ideas came to mind.” He then mentioned three mega-projects, stating, “This place, Iksan, and North Jeolla, will make an astonishing leap forward.” <<> Kim also shared the story of setting up a home in Iksan. He said, “Iksan is the place where I fell in love during my 18 years as a private citizen,” and “With good transportation, good food, good people, and a deep history, I had my eye on Iksan for a decade, thinking I’d build a house and live there when I grew old. I became an honorary citizen and found a home for my mother-in-law’s care and my own stay.” He also shared a photo of a banner reading, “Welcome to Prime Minister Kim Min-seok’s residency.” <<> Honam is home to about one-third of the Democratic Party’s paid members and is considered a key battleground in the August party leadership election. Another leadership contender, Assemblyman Song Young-gil, is also expected to visit Honam soon. (더불어민주당 당 대표를 뽑는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 당권 주자들이 4일 호남 지역을 찾았다. 정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표는 전남 신안군에 있는 김대중 전 대통령 생가를 방문했고, 김민석 전 국무총리는 전북 익산에 마련한 집에 머물렀다.)

item.title: Blue House Warns Lee Byung-tae: "Inappropriate Conduct for Someone in a Responsible Position" (靑, 이병태에 “책임있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신”)
item.description:
Blue House Warns Lee Byung-tae: "Inappropriate Conduct for Someone in a Responsible Position" (靑, 이병태에 “책임있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신” )

The presidential office Cheong Wa Dae issued a stern warning on the 4th regarding Lee Byung-tae, Vice Chairman of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Reform, for criticizing the disciplinary action against Baejae High School's baseball team, stating that "as someone in a responsible position within a government-affiliated agency, his conduct was inappropriate." (청와대가 4일 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 배재고 야구부 징계 사태를 비판한 것에 대해 “정부 소속 기관의 책임있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신”이라며 엄중 경고했다고 밝혔다.)

Kang Yoo-jung, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations, stated that day, "Vice Chairman Lee Byung-tae posted personal opinions on social media," adding, "This carries the risk of misunderstanding, contrary to the government's firm stance against hatred and ridicule." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “이병태 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 개인적 의견을 SNS에 게시한 바 있다”며 “이는 혐오와 조롱에 대한 정부의 단호한 거부 기조와 달리 오해의 소지가 있다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 2nd, Vice Chairman Lee posted on his social media that the Baejae High School baseball team, which had chanted a "Starbucks cheer song" directed at Gwangju Jeil High School during a game and faced heavy disciplinary action amid controversy over disparaging the May 18 Democratic Uprising, was "like North Korea" and that "May 18 has become a sacred cow." As criticism from within the ruling bloc emerged, he continued his argument on the 4th, saying, "This denies the democracy (freedom of expression) that the Gwangju Democratization Movement pursued." (앞서 이 부위원장은 지난 2일 자신의 SNS를 통해 배재고 야구부가 경기 도중 광주제일고를 향해 ‘스타벅스 응원가’를 구호로 외쳐 5·18 폄훼 논란으로 중징계를 받자 “북한 같다” “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 했다. 이를 두고 범여권 비판이 나오자, 4일에도 “광주 민주화운동이 추구했던 민주주의(표현의 자유)를 부정하는 것”이라며 주장을 이어갔다.)

In response, Senior Secretary Kang stated, "Especially as someone in a responsible position within a government-affiliated agency, this was inappropriate conduct," and "We have issued a stern warning and strongly requested that such incidents be prevented from recurring in the future." <<>> (이에 대해 강 수석대변인은 “특히 정부 소속 기관의 책임있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신”이라며 “이에 엄중히 경고하고, 향후 재발 방지를 강력히 요청했음을 알린다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "Is the May 18 a Sanctuary?" Choi Min-hee: "Yes, It Is." (이병태 “5·18 성역인가" 최민희 “네, 성역 맞습니다”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae: "Is the May 18 a Sanctuary?" Choi Min-hee: "Yes, It Is." (이병태 “5·18 성역인가" 최민희 “네, 성역 맞습니다”)

As political controversy spreads surrounding Baejae High School's baseball team, which received severe punishment for a 'Starbucks cheering song', Choi Min-hee, a member of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated, "The May 18 Democratic Uprising is indeed a sanctuary of democracy." <<> On the 3rd, Rep. Choi posted on her Facebook and X (formerly Twitter): "Deputy Chairman Lee Byung-tae of the Regulatory Reform Committee asks, 'Is the May 18 a sanctuary?' Here is my answer: 'Yes, it is. It is a sanctuary of democracy.'" <<> This is a public rebuttal of Lee Byung-tae, deputy chairman of the Presidential Regulatory Reform Committee, who had previously said regarding the severe punishment of Baejae High School's baseball team for mocking the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement: "The May 18 has become a sanctuary" and "It looks like something from North Korea." <<> In response to Deputy Chairman Lee's remarks, criticism is mounting among pro-Moon and pro-Cheong supporters within the conservative camp. On the 'Ddanji Ilbo' message board and social media, popular among pro-Moon and pro-Cheong followers, critical posts are appearing such as: "Why put such a person in a presidential agency?" "New Lee Jae-myung, you'll fail like this," and "The true nature of the New Lee Jae-myung is revealed." <<> Deputy Chairman Lee Byung-tae, a former KAIST professor and close associate of former Daegu Mayor Hong Joon-pyo, is referred to as a 'New Lee Jae-myung' figure appointed by President Lee. During the last presidential election, President Lee attempted to bring Deputy Chairman Lee into his campaign committee, but his past 'inflammatory remarks' against former President Moon Jae-in were criticized, and the plan was abandoned due to opposition from some figures. <<> Even after President Lee announced Deputy Chairman Lee's appointment on the 3rd, the Fatherland Innovation Party and Democratic Party lawmaker Park Joo-min have been demanding, "Please reconsider the selection." (‘스타벅스 응원가’로 중징계를 받은 배재고 야구부를 둘러싼 정치권 논란이 확산하는 가운데, 최민희 더불어민주당 의원이 “5·18은 민주주의의 성역이 맞다”고 밝혔다.)
